luck.headline: Extra wins
luck.description: Actual matchup wins minus expected all-play wins. A positive number means the schedule helped.

historicalDna.scoringStrength: Within each completed season, team mean final PF per week divided by league mean final PF per week, minus one. Weighted mean of those league-relative strengths.
historicalDna.volatility: Within each completed season, population standard deviation of 14 regular-season final weekly PF divided by team mean PF. Weighted mean of season CVs.
historicalDna.classification: Use existing scoring quadrants, with weighted relative PF >= 0 for the above-league axis and weighted CV > scoring.quadrantCvBoundary for volatility.
historicalDna.availableWeights: Choose the latest up to three verified completed seasons for the same franchise and normalize available 50/30/20 weights to sum to 100%.
historicalDna.allTime: Equal-weight all verified completed seasons of the same franchise; observed quadrant persistence never recency-weighted.
historicalDna.activeSeason: Never blend ongoing 2026 data into Historical DNA; Current DNA remains separate.
historicalDna.franchiseContinuity: Explicit season + ESPN team slot mapping; 2023 ESPN slot 6 differs from 2024+.

acquisitionDna.scope: Finalized regular-season starter appearances; source is the most recent verified acquisition INTO the same franchise before that player's fantasy-game lineup lock.

sourceDefinitions.draft: Picked by this franchise in the original season draft and retained continuously to the starter appearance
sourceDefinitions.trade: Most recent entry into this franchise was an executed trade
sourceDefinitions.waiver: Most recent entry was a processed waiver claim
sourceDefinitions.free_agent: Most recent entry was an unrestricted free-agent add
sourceDefinitions.keeper: Player entered the current season through an ESPN-verified keeper allocation; do not infer
sourceDefinitions.other: Verified commissioner/manual acquisition not otherwise classified
sourceDefinitions.unknown: Acquisition chain is missing, contradictory, post-lock or unverified; always included in mix denominator

mix.denominator: One finalized starter appearance = one starter-week, regardless of points or slot. All regular-season starters including K, D/ST and historical P are included; unknown is not discarded.
mix.numerator: Starter-weeks whose player's most recent verified entry into that franchise had the indicated source
mix.crossSeason: Calculate each season separately. Display lifetime context as equal-weight means of complete verified seasons, never pool 9-slot and punter-era denominators.

yield.denominator: Within each source, sum eligible position-weighted starter opportunities with independently verified league-wide same-week slot qualification
yield.numerator: Within that source, sum weighted starter-worthy hits; K and D/ST count 0.5 and other 2026 skill slots count 1
yield.status: N/A until source and full year-specific player quality coverage are validated; conditional performance of starts, not causal acquisition skill or draft ROI

execution.denominator: Sum of independently verified best attainable legal roster quality from actual starters and bench, excluding IR
execution.numerator: Sum of independently verified realized starter-worthy quality; if zero attainable ceiling show N/A
execution.separation: A team-level lineup choice metric, not source-specific; do not call ceiling shortfall an execution failure

guards: Player identity must use original season ESPN player ID, league ID, week, franchise ID and assigned legal lineup slot; never match players by display name
Use latest acquisition into the specific franchise; after a drop and reacquisition, prior draft credit does not persist
One player can supply a distinct starter appearance each completed week; no duplicate starter IDs in a franchise-week or two teams in a league-week
Enforce verified season-specific starting slot counts and completed week coverage before publication
Never backfill unknown starter sources by assumption, owner ID, team name or current roster state
Historical starter-worthy yield unavailable until original-year full player pool and lineup rules are reconciled; punter-era SWR must not reuse 2026 denominator
Mix and yield use regular-season finalized snapshots only, not pre-lock substitutions or unverified estimates
